objections.statement: A single cell might hide cross-control dependencies such as deployment before rollback.
A receipt writer might be mistaken for an effect controller.

reconciliation: Add typed dependency receipt refs while keeping each control predicate independent.
Constrain the writer to append-only evidence and exclude all effect endpoints and credentials.
balanced_unit: ControlEvaluationCell with exact binding, observation and dependency receipt inputs; typed evaluator; append-only receipt output; no protected-effect interface.
recomposition_proof: Cells form the exact claim-specific DAG described by C01-C20; an aggregate consumes only terminal child receipts, while authorization remains outside the DAG.
